title: Baruapepe ya Kiofisi (Theme 15: Maadili ya kijamii)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the features of an office email: the address, a clear subject, a formal greeting, a short message, a formal closing with a full name and title, and cc where needed.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the parts of an email.
floor.question: Kichwa cha baruapepe ni cha nini?

contexts: an email to a county office

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels the parts of an office email.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni sehemu ipi ya baruapepe inaonyesha kichwa cha habari?" Kwa nini "jina la mwandishi" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Lugha ya baruapepe ya kiofisi ni ipi?" Kwa nini "ya mtaani" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Baruapepe ya kiofisi ni rasmi na fupi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Anwani ya mpokeaji huandikwa wapi?" Kwa nini "mwishoni" si jibu sahihi?

listen_for: katika kisanduku cha "Kwa" pamoja na mratibu
misconceptions.repair: "Nakala kwa" ni ya mtu anayepaswa kujua tu.

checks.question: Baruapepe ya kiofisi humalizika vipi?
checks.answer: Wako mwaminifu, jina kamili na cheo

skills.key_step: The child plans baruapepe before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: ombi la kushiriki kongamano la maadili
a letter or story for a family member

board.do: Ombi la Kushiriki Kongamano la Maadili

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Ombi la Kushiriki Kongamano la Maadili".

misconceptions.ask: Mpokeaji ataona nini kwanza kwenye sanduku lake?
misconceptions.repair: Kichwa cha baruapepe ni maneno machache yanayoeleza ujumbe unahusu nini.

listen_for: S.L.P. 120, Nakuru, na tarehe juu kulia
misconceptions.repair: Baruapepe haina anwani ya posta wala tarehe juu; kifaa huziweka chenyewe.

misconceptions.ask: Anwani ya baruapepe ina alama gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kisanduku cha "Kwa" huandikwa anwani ya baruapepe ya mpokeaji, yenye @.

misconceptions.ask: Maneno haya yangeeleweka na kila mtu?
misconceptions.repair: Baruapepe huandikwa kwa lugha sahihi, na humalizika kwa hitimisho na jina.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika baruapepe kuhusu "Ombi la Kushiriki Kongamano la Maadili"?
Baruapepe ina sehemu zipi?
checks.answer: anwani ya mpokeaji, kichwa, salamu, ujumbe, hitimisho
